source.name: Hand of Midas
source.description:
Active ability: Instant Activation
 Immediately eliminates a summoned or illusion piece with health lower than the carrier. In-home battles, drops 1 gold coins.

descriptions.en:
Active ability: Instant Activation
 Immediately eliminates a summoned or illusion piece with health lower than the carrier. In-home battles, drops 1 gold coins.
descriptions.ru:
Нацеленная Активка: Мгновенная
 Немедленно уничтожает призванную или иллюзорную фигуру с меньшим здоровьем, чем у носителя. В домашних битвах дает 1 золотую монету.
descriptions.zh-cn:
主动技能：立即激活
立即消灭一个生命值低于携带者的召唤物或幻象。如果是主场作战，同时会掉落1个金币。
descriptions.zh-tw:
主動技能：立即激活
立即消滅一個生命值低於攜帶者的召喚物或幻象。如果是主場作戰，同時會掉落1個金幣。

source.lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owners pockets.

lore_i18n.en: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owners pockets.
lore_i18n.ru: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owners pockets.
lore_i18n.zh-cn: 以未知的魔法手段维持着的迈达斯之手，是件贪婪的武器，通过炼化生灵来装满持有者的腰包。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 以未知的魔法手段維持着的邁達斯之手，是件貪婪的武器，通過煉化生靈來裝滿持有者的腰包。
